findings.dependency_evidence: The direct compat-core>=1.8.0,<2.0.0 path and the query-base==2.0.0 transitive compat-core>=2.0.0 path have an empty effective intersection in every supported environment. Metadata coverage is partial, but the conflicting mandatory paths alone prove that the graph is uninstallable, so runtime compatibility is broken even though no concrete supported resolution exists.
findings.suggestion: Update the direct compat-core requirement to >=2.0.0, the first version that exports FeatureUnavailable, removing the obsolete <2.0.0 cap.
